sources.fact: The reviewed source parses AcDs segment/index structures, but its SAB recovery scans for ACIS BinaryFile and End of ASM data markers and pairs each recovered span with the next queued acis_sab_hdl entry; it checks aggregate counts at the end. The shown _data_ and blob01 cases are unhandled. This is mutable-master source inspection, not a runtime result or proof that the ordering is wrong for every producer.
The R2007 decoder invokes the AcDs section parser; source presence does not establish complete schema interpretation, exact entity-to-payload binding, or current released behavior.

The open report gives a from-scratch ezdxf AC1032 REGION/cube control with a 5489-byte SAB and reports silent payload/ACDSDATA loss through LibreDWG 0.14.8593 at 8a1ae764 in DXF-to-DWG-to-DXF conversion. The confidential AutoCAD drawing is unavailable; the report is not a result for current master.
The report describes ACIS solids read from DWG but silently omitted by a DXF writer, including solid-only blocks; the maintainer says these entity types were not yet supported by that DXF writer.
The issue-linked ACIS DXF writer change remained open in the current pull request list at the time of review; an unmerged branch is not released writer behavior.
ezdxf documents no ACIS kernel and flat-polygon-only mesh extraction from ACIS bodies; this is useful carrier/projection evidence but not arbitrary curved B-rep semantics.
FreeCAD documentation describes the stock DXF importer routes and says ACIS/SAT blobs cannot currently be read; the documentation is not a runtime result for a pinned build.
A maintainer response says stock FreeCAD cannot read the proprietary ACIS blob and recommends conversion to an open format; the issue is route-boundary evidence, not native qualification.

disposition.implementationImpact: Refine existing AcDs per-entity association and optional peer-comparison gates; do not add a new finding or block local implementation.

localSourceReview.finding: Existing generated coverage links two distinct payload vectors to A17/A18 after reversed entity traversal and checks each handle/key/payload association; no duplicate local test is needed for that invariant.
